caption: The drawing shows a single object, which is a hand tool known as a brace. The brace is positioned upright against a plain, light-colored background. The main body of the brace is composed of a medium brown material, possibly suggesting wood, with visible curves and an ergonomic handle shape in the midsection. Along the outer bend of the brace, there are yellowish metal plates affixed to the wood with round-headed screws or rivets, adding contrasting textures and color. The upper part of the brace has a round, flat-topped knob, also brown in color, likely the top handle. At the lower end, there is a metallic drill bit chuck, rendered in a grayish steel color, indicating the area where a drill bit would be inserted. The overall composition is centered and the background remains unadorned, focusing attention solely on the detailed depiction of the brace.
title: Carpenter's Brace
